note: Room Sim and Sionna RT are both simulators: every number here is SIM, an agreement or disagreement between two models of the same declared rooms, never a property of a real room.

settings.antennas: iso pattern, V polarisation, at every node (tx and rx)

d_los_db.meaning: LoS (direct) path power, Room Sim minus Sionna

d_spec_db.meaning: total specular power up to order 2, Room Sim minus Sionna

cfr_corr.meaning: correlation of |H| (dB) over the 52 LLTF subcarriers

cfr_corr_selective.meaning: the same correlation, links where both selectivities are >= 1 dB

cfr_rms_db.meaning: RMS of the |H| difference (dB) after removing its mean

cfr_offset_db.meaning: mean |H| difference (dB), Room Sim minus Sionna

d_ds_ns.meaning: RMS delay spread, Room Sim minus Sionna

sel_rs_db.meaning: frequency selectivity (std of |H| dB over 52 subcarriers), Room Sim

d_sel_db.meaning: frequency selectivity, Room Sim minus Sionna

higher_order_db.meaning: Sionna power with 3..4 reflections added, relative to order <= 2

rs_only_frac_db.meaning: power of Room Sim paths Sionna lacks, relative to Room Sim's specular power

s_only_frac_db.meaning: power of Sionna paths Room Sim lacks, relative to Sionna's order <= 2 power

ds_rs_full_ns.meaning: RMS delay spread, Room Sim full model (realized tail and clutter)

ds_rs_full_expected_ns.meaning: RMS delay spread, Room Sim full model with the tail by expectation

ds_s_full_ns.meaning: RMS delay spread, Sionna with diffuse reflection

d_ds_full_ns.meaning: RMS delay spread, Room Sim full (realized) minus Sionna diffuse

sel_rs_full_db.meaning: frequency selectivity, Room Sim full model

sel_s_full_db.meaning: frequency selectivity, Sionna with diffuse reflection

d_sel_full_db.meaning: frequency selectivity, Room Sim full minus Sionna diffuse

ds_rs_spec_ns.meaning: RMS delay spread, Room Sim kinds 0..3 only

ds_s_spec_ns.meaning: RMS delay spread, the specular paths of Sionna's diffuse run (orders <= 4)

stoch_rs_db.meaning: Room Sim points + clutter + tail power, relative to its kinds 0..3

diffuse_s_db.meaning: Sionna diffuse power, relative to its specular paths in the same run

points_rs_db.meaning: Room Sim object point scatterers (kind 4), relative to kinds 0..3

clutter_rs_db.meaning: Room Sim clutter (kind 5), relative to kinds 0..3

tail_rs_db.meaning: Room Sim tail (kind 6, realized), relative to kinds 0..3

ds_rs_spec_plus_points_ns.meaning: RMS delay spread, Room Sim kinds 0..3 + point scatterers

ds_rs_spec_plus_clutter_ns.meaning: RMS delay spread, Room Sim kinds 0..3 + clutter

ds_rs_spec_plus_tail_ns.meaning: RMS delay spread, Room Sim kinds 0..3 + tail (realized)

ds_rs_tail_at_los_expected_ns.meaning: what-if, not Room Sim's model: full-model delay spread, tail by expectation but starting at the LoS delay
